known.summary: The contract's Linked branch section says to set up the branch after the plan is ongoing, but yolo sets it up right after `new` while the Yolo runs table has no timing override (its intro keeps every other rule in force), and yolo's Recover after compaction reads the branch from `gh issue view --json closedByPullRequestsReferences`, which carries no branch name.

Engineering standards gives 'Commits and the pull request description' to `commit-discipline`, while Landing makes the run summary the pull request body, so a yolo run has two conflicting rules for the pull request description.

Landing writes the run summary, which holds the pull request URL and the check state, before the pull request and its checks exist and never updates the body afterward, and it always runs `gh pr create`, even when the branch already has an open pull request.

The yolo skill always drafts a new plan (no rule to adopt an open plan or pull request, or to read an incomplete request) and has no rule for checks that instruction files require, failures outside the goal, red baselines, the self-review record, or commit timing; it applies `code-clarity` only to names and comments, does not return a used user checkout to the default branch after the merge, and its run summary has no place for failed or partial checks.
